fields.label: Capability
fields.text: Lilly-trained ADMET/safety/preclinical prediction models offered to outside biotechs; partners return data via federated learning.

fields.label: Initial problem
fields.text: Small biotechs lack consistent assay data; Lilly wants more training data and ecosystem pull (Catalyze360).

fields.label: Execution timeline
fields.text: Launched 2025-09-09 [CLM-000280]; insitro ADMET models for it announced the same day [CLM-006009]; Benchling distribution announced 2026-01-08, opt-in "later this year" [CLM-006008]; Revvity Signals channel indicated mid-2026 (metadata only, SRC-006035).

fields.label: Evidence of value
fields.text: None independent. No uptake, retraining count or scientific result disclosed [CLM-006008].

fields.label: Maturity
fields.text: operational (platform live) with distribution at pilot.

fields.label: Durability
fields.text: Data moat is real if volume and consistency are as claimed; federated design means partner data improves Lilly-led models, strengthening lock-in (INTERPRETATION) [CLM-006055].

fields.label: Competitive response
fields.text: Multi-pharma consortia (AISB) and open models (OpenFold3, Boltz, Chai) offer substitutes [CLM-006056, CLM-006042].
